acceptanceCriteria: A change under `docs/` selects the packages whose tests read the changed files, with the rule named in the plan.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews of the V1 wave-1/wave-2 pull requests (#74-#82). Review of PR #74 (V1-0002): `corvint affected` returned EMPTY_SELECTION for a docs-only change while at least eight packages read docs in tests.
title: affected: docs-only changes select no packages although eight packages read docs
